**Finding: MISSING** (medium severity, confidence 0.86)

**What I checked:** Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment — p0023–p0029), Section 1 (HDI's hosting responsibilities), Section 8 (Confidentiality), and Section 10.7 (Survival). I also searched for "termination," "Content," and data-return language across the whole document.

**Why it's missing:** Section 4 covers only the renewal/notice mechanics and the Termination Payment formula. There is no exit, transition, migration, data-export or deletion provision anywhere. That gap matters here because HDI hosts the Site on its own server (1.3), controls the system on which the Site is stored (1.4), and is expressly exposed to our "Content, user information, data... and trade secret information" (8.1). The confidentiality obligations restrict use and disclosure but never require return or deletion, and the survival clause (10.7) doesn't reach Section 4. On termination we would have no right to recover our own data or to any migration help — below even the playbook fallback of 90 days' assistance plus 30-day export.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** New Section 4.3 inserted after p0029, at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates including Site migration cooperation, return of Content/user information/customer data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification. The accompanying comment flags 90 days of assistance as an acceptable fallback while holding firm on the 30-day data return.
